owner: coverage sidecar; Hilbert executes only after main approval

policy.on_failure: Continue independent cases after ordinary RTL failures, mismatches or bounded DUT timeouts; retain first-failure evidence and group repeated failures. Stop the shared queue only for infrastructure, hash/integrity or checker failures. Do not repair RTL, retry automatically, or change seeds, limits or oracle.
policy.coverage_claim: Functional exploration only on frozen VCS; do not call historical Verilator percentages current or merge different image hashes.
policy.identity: Never rename/reuse case IDs. Random identity includes alias+effective-options hash+seed; directed includes exact test ID+ELF hash. Input drift aborts; revised inputs require a new plan version.

generator.compatibility: Aliases retain riscv_instr_base_test, target, RTL test and all source gen_opts except instr_cnt; no generator compile needed for alias names. Pin complete generator runtime in prepared-inputs before launch.

random_defaults.instruction_count_scope: 300 generator body instructions, not total ELF instructions, retirement count or cycles; directed streams and exit signatures add work.

directed_defaults.command: verify.py run --test <exact test> --simv <frozen image> --skip-build --jobs 1 --commit-trace --timeout <case timeout> --output <new directory>
directed_defaults.contract: Program self-check+zero exit+Core SUCCESS+no failure diagnostics+trace/provenance; do not falsely require Spike on custom QBS/AKV instructions.
directed_defaults.freeze: Before dispatch copy each pinned apps/bin ELF into private run inputs; fail any hash mismatch; never rebuild or overwrite apps/bin.

scheduling.compile_scope: Generated random ELF compilation only; no RTL/image build or existing directed ELF rebuild.
scheduling.run_order: One seed per profile plus segment/restart/QBS-AKV sentinels first; then round-robin remaining seeds across all ten profiles and directed groups. No same-profile twenty-case blind batch.
scheduling.global_failure_action: Continue ordinary RTL case failures; stop the shared queue on infrastructure, hash/integrity or checker failures and retain all artifacts.
scheduling.post_batch: Coverage replay is already authorized: report exploration coverage including failed prefixes separately from coverage backed by independently checked PASS cases. Failed-prefix coverage is not correctness evidence. Bind each replay to its coverage image/source hashes; do not merge incompatible images or request an additional approval gate.
scheduling.estimate_basis: Planning estimate only; historical directed cases often tens of seconds. All-248-at-600s with five complete-job slots is about 8.3h plus setup, not a promised runtime.

priority_order: QBS/AKV control and real small-kernel handoff
coverage_priorities.post_batch: Publish strict functional results and retired activity separately; select passing cases for a later same-source instrumented coverage checkpoint only after user approval.
